about_the_game:
This soundtrack is a curated collection of cyberpunk, synthwave, and electronic tracks that define the atmosphere of the game.

Real Art, Real People Every track here was composed by a human being. Zero AI was used. This collection is only possible thanks to the amazing Creative Commons community. For full licensing details and to see more from the creators, please follow the "Visit the Website" link on the right.

A Note on File Quality You’ll notice there are no high-quality/lossless files included here. This is intentional. Many of these artists sell high-quality versions of their music independently, and I want to ensure I’m not cutting into their livelihood. If a track resonates with you, please consider supporting the artist directly by purchasing their high-res work.

  • “Space Time” & “Fear Zone” by Lufus

  • “False Noise” By Revan is licensed under a Creative Commons License

  • “Piercer” By Revan is licensed under a Creative Commons License

  • “Dead or Alive” By AKIRA is licensed under a Creative Commons License

  • “DEATH WISH” By AKIRA is licensed under a Creative Commons License

  • “RIDE 1989” By AKIRA is licensed under a Creative Commons License

  • “Dark Night” By AKIRA is licensed under a Creative Commons License

  • “Killer” By AKIRA is licensed under a Creative Commons License

  • “DEAD” By AKIRA is licensed under a Creative Commons License

  • “Breach” By Gereon is licensed under a Creative Commons License

  • “Monorail” By Gereon is licensed under a Creative Commons License

  • “Tiger” By Gereon is licensed under a Creative Commons License

  • “Data Leak” by Noah Giesler is licensed under a  Creative Commons License

  • “carnage” By heylog is licensed under a Creative Commons License

Find information about the tracks' licenses on the website linked on this page.
